What will you do
As an active logistics team member at PostNL, you will stay moving throughout your entire shift 🌙 You will ensure incoming and outgoing trucks are loaded and unloaded at top speed. Enjoy a flexible routine night shift, keeping the entire postal network moving with your dedication.

You will join the bustling PostNL parcel hub situated at Ketelaarskampweg 4 in 's-Hertogenbosch. The depot is easily accessible by car, scooter, or bicycle 🚴🏾‍♂️ You will become part of an international crew where hard work and high spirits go hand in hand. With English widely spoken on the floor, you might even pick up a few extra language skills along the way! Your effort is genuinely appreciated, so expect strong team spirit and occasional treats on the work floor.
